name: sub_bar
_comment: Wave 12 item 5: submunition fuse vs an ELONGATED target. Kit Sub Range, the target 150 px north of Kit Sub Port: Kit Sub Bar Side (mïsn 1055: a 76 x 14 magenta bar lying across the line of fire, the same on every frame) or Kit Sub Bar End (mïsn 1056: the bar upright, end-on to the player). The player (Kit Ring Crawler at rest) fires the slow parents 268-273 (Speed 200 = 2 px a frame, prox 0 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 30) one at a time; read where each detonated (and whether it subbed) from the recording. Pilots w12_sub_side, w12_sub_end.
